titles.romaji: Taimanin Asagi: Toraware no Niku Ningyou
titles.native: 対魔忍アサギ～捕らわれの肉人形～

description: Japan, sometime in the near future where a group of shinobi have been brought together and trained to deal with the demon threat that has persisted for some time. It has long been the case that demons and humans avoided each other, but that belief is about to be destroyed.
